The pulse is linearly chirped: its carrier frequency $\omega$ grows in time as
$\omega = \omega_0 + \alpha t$, and the field is $E \propto \cos(\omega t)$.
The photon energy is $\hbar$ times the time derivative of the phase,
\begin{equation}
\hbar \frac{d(\omega t)}{dt} = \hbar\omega .
\label{eq:chirp}
\end{equation}
